featuresPage.seoDescription: Explore FilamentHub features: filament catalog, OrcaSlicer presets, spool inventory, printer integrations, calculations, and orders.
featuresPage.title: From a spool on the shelf to a finished print
featuresPage.subtitle: FilamentHub connects material records, working presets, physical spools, OrcaSlicer, printers, and calculations. This page is a concise product map; the guides explain each workflow step by step.
featuresPage.principleText: You do not have to re-enter the same context in disconnected tables: a material record leads to a preset, the preset prepares the print, and your physical spool confirms the available stock.
featuresPage.cardsSubtitle: The areas work together, while each remains useful on its own.

cards.title: Find materials
cards.text: Search product variants by manufacturer, material type, color, composition, properties, and available print data.

cards.title: Work with presets
cards.text: Choose ready presets, create your own, import drafts, and move settings between FilamentHub and OrcaSlicer.

cards.title: Track physical spools
cards.text: Keep physical spools separate, follow remaining stock, and link them to materials and presets without losing data provenance.

cards.title: Connect equipment
cards.text: Map spools to feed-system slots and receive available observed data through supported adapters.

cards.title: Calculate jobs and orders
cards.text: Analyze G-code, estimate material, time, and cost, prepare quotes, and preserve the working history.

cards.title: Represent a brand
cards.text: Maintain a verified brand page, official materials and presets, regional data, and FilamentHub QR codes.

flows.title: 3D printing users
flows.text: Find the right material and preset faster, track real spools, and keep the print context intact.

flows.title: Workshops
flows.text: Connect calculations, clients, quotes, orders, material stock, and equipment in one workflow.

flows.title: Manufacturers
flows.text: Give users verified material data and a short path from the package to the correct preset.

featuresPage.guideTitle: Need a clear first step rather than a feature list?
featuresPage.guideText: The guides demonstrate real actions step by step, from finding or scanning a spool to a preset, printer, and calculation.
